description: Track user input flowing across module boundaries — detects injection vulnerabilities spanning multiple files. Pass files array with file contents. For single-file analysis, use analyze_dataflow instead. Example: analyze_cross_file_dataflow({files: [{path: 'src/api.ts', content: '...'}, {path: 'src/db.ts', content: '...'}]})

files.description: List of files to analyze (ignored when path is provided)

path.description: Project directory path. When provided, auto-discovers all JS/TS files — no need to pass file contents manually.

name: analyze_cross_file_dataflow
